scenes.title: Agents collaborate
lines: Across government, AI agents are beginning to work together on citizen services: checking eligibility, sharing tasks, and collecting fees.

scenes.title: A legitimate agent oversteps
lines: But what happens when a legitimate agent, with a genuine identity, reaches for another citizen's record, one it was never authorized to see?

scenes.title: WAKALA blocks it
lines: WAKALA checks every request against signed, case-specific authority.
In our working prototype, the request is blocked before any protected data is returned.

scenes.title: An officer restores valid authority
lines: An authorized security officer reviews the incident, contains only the affected authority, and hands the task to a trusted standby agent.

scenes.title: The service recovers
lines: After the required approval, Mariam's renewal completes safely, every decision stays on record, and another citizen's application continues untouched.
